

# BOU EL MOGDAD

## Additional Programs \*

\* Pre/Post Cruise Traveling

### Océan & Savane

The cruise is an ideal opportunity to discover the Océan & Savane lodge and its unique surroundings situated in a Natural Park, along the river Senegal and facing the Langue de Barbarie, with a view on the Ocean on the horizon.

This haven of peace especially adapted for stays in couples or families is inviting you to relax and for a change of scenery.

An aerial photograph showing a wide, turquoise river with a sandy beach on its right bank. The river flows towards the horizon, where it meets the sea. The right bank is covered with sparse, dry vegetation and some trees. The sky is clear and blue.

Photo: Aerial view of a wide river flowing into a sandy beach and the sea.

### Jeep Road Trip

Combining a unique adventurous moment in a Willys jeep discovering the variety of landscapes of Senegal and its authentic villages, off the beaten tracks.

From Lake Rose to Saint Louis through the beach and the dirt tracks into the Senegalese bush, meeting a warm and still genuine culture.

A vintage, light-colored military jeep is shown driving through a river, creating a splash of water. The jeep has a blue license plate that reads "UK-H165". The background shows a dry, arid landscape with some trees and a person standing in the distance.

## A Walk to the End of the Bou

It is quite difficult to come all the way to Podor with the Bou el Mogdad and to leave it without taking the time to discover its charm, its secrets and its surprises.

The formula called “Balade au bout du Bou” (“a walk to the end of the Bou”) is offered as an extension of the cruise to allow those who finish it, and those who start it, to discover Podor and its surrounding region.
